info.description: A curated read-only subset of Microsoft Graph v1.0 for Outlook, shipped with the mcpx outlook example declaration (#1936). The full Graph document covers every Microsoft 365 service and is tens of megabytes; this document covers only the read operations the declaration exposes: listing and reading messages, listing mail folders, listing calendar events, and reading the caller's own profile.
info.title: Outlook via Microsoft Graph (mcpx example subset)

get.description: Returns the profile of the user the access token belongs to: display name, mail address and user principal name.
Lists events on the caller's default calendar. $filter can bound the window, e.g. start/dateTime ge '2026-01-01T00:00:00Z'.

parameters.description: Maximum number of events to return.
parameters.name: $top

parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to include for each event.
parameters.name: $select

get.description: Lists the caller's top-level mail folders with their message and unread counts (Inbox, Sent Items, Drafts and any custom folders).

parameters.description: Maximum number of folders to return.
parameters.name: $top

get.description: Lists messages in the caller's mailbox, newest first by default. $search matches message content; $filter is an OData filter; $select trims the fields returned.

parameters.description: A search expression matched against message content.
parameters.name: $search

parameters.description: Maximum number of messages to return.
parameters.name: $top

parameters.description: Comma-separated fields to include for each message.
parameters.name: $select

get.description: Returns one message in full: subject, sender, recipients, received time and body.
